additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419002-DC/Si-D/FR-[ MP / P0 170001104 ]  Issue while starting charger CRM:02684000120
additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien Bonhomme,
Upon reviewing the logs for the reported time when the vehicle attempted to charge via the AC outlet, we observed that the ID tag "05038C06810000" was successfully accepted. However, we identified the following log entry:
{"vendorId":"TariffInformation","messageId":"SetUserPrice","data":"{\"idToken\":\"05038C06810000\",\"description\":{\"en\":\"Tariff is not available.\"}}"}
This log entry indicates that the charging session was unable to proceed due to the "Tariff is not available" message. It appears that the charging service could not retrieve the required tariff information, which prevented the system from processing the charging request.
If you have any further questions or need additional clarification, please do not hesitate to contact us. Otherwise, we are happy to proceed with closing the ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419002-DC/Si-D/FR-[ MP / P0 170001104 ]  Issue while starting charger CRM:02684000120
additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien Bonhomme,
Greetings of the day!
We were unable to determine why the tariff was not available. You may wish to consult your OCPP backend provider for further investigation.
However, we observed that on the same day, a charging session was successfully completed on the AC charging outlet using the "idTag":"q8b8dmp9hrrejegs".
It is possible that the earlier charging session failed due to an error on the EV side, which we are unable to verify from our end. Nevertheless, the AC charging outlet has been functioning normally since.
Please let us know if we can proceed with closing the ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
